expectations.text: Does NOT recommend a bare flip

Single-flight: "`drain_comps_fanin` is **single-flight** (global advisory lock ...) so there is no parallel speedup." Plus throughput vs inflow (2.2–13.6 h/day of matcher work).

expectations.text: Investigates WHY the flag is off rather than assuming
